name: Impulsor Hub Cloud Workspace
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/impulsor-hub && if [ ! -d ui/dist ]; then cd ui && npm install --silent && npm run build && cd ..; fi && pkill -f "uvicorn app.api.main:app" 2>/dev/null || true; nohup uvicorn app.api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/impulsor-hub.log 2>&1 & sleep 1
